clusters.mechanism: passed() rejects a whole gate check if any unrelated file was skipped, so a fully passing loopback file cannot supply evidence (e.g. under LIMITLESS_CONFINED skips).
covers() accepts matching command arguments without checking passedFiles, but Bun treats bare test arguments as substring filters, so the requested file may never have run yet evidence is accepted.
gateClaim treats any standalone mention of 'gate/gates' (including in verify.notes) as a factory citation, so independently observed evidence is downgraded from met to blocked.
Unchanged HEAD is treated as proof that gates tested the committed tree, though gate setup or earlier checks may have modified tracked files before tests ran and were then reset.
